title: Formals refused because the never-bound closure treats every mention in an uncontracted call's actuals as a possible binding
why: Measured by W47-ALIAS-RESIDUALS-CENSUS on the integrated wave-47 baseline (3ba72320; artifacts/census/tables.json, group formal-handed-uncontracted): 2,350 of the corpus's 7,440 unknown_alias leaves (806 first leaves of a (function, name) pair) are a pointer formal no statement assigns, dereferenced or read, whose name is mentioned inside an actual of an uncontracted callee (2,284 leaves with a corpus-defined callee among them, 66 only external or indirect; librdkafka 1,948 leaves, driven by the rd_slice_*/rd_kafka_buf_read_* macros `rd_slice_read(&(rkbuf)->rkbuf_reader, ...)`, rd_kafka_log0 and rd_strlcpy). UntrackedBases::never_bound (rule 5b's premise) refuses any name passed at any position of an uncontracted call, and the chain obligation refuses an unbound root the closure does not prove never bound; the typed parity rows agree (2,060 leaves carry root_never_bound false, 98 true, 192 have no typed row). 732 Unknown functions have such a leaf, 399 have no other alias class, 108 are blocked by it plus exactly one other family (74 IND, 32 UNC), none alone; system slice 176 leaves / 37 functions. DISCHARGE: a closure answer that admits a mention at a position the callee's contract or validated W4 summary declares Borrowed, and a member or member-address mention (`&(p)->f`) that hands no copy of p, each with a soundness argument that the callee cannot bind, release or retain p through that position, matching audited Lean, negative controls (a releasing, storing, variadic-tail and uncontracted position) and a measured corpus/system re-pin; never a relaxation for an uncontracted callee's own position.

title: Names Clang types as non-pointers reported as unresolved resource identities
why: Measured by W47-ALIAS-RESIDUALS-CENSUS (group non-pointer-name): 930 corpus unknown_alias leaves name something Clang does not type as a pointer object: 393 scalar locals or formals (`if (result == 0)`, `return ret;`), 267 enumeration constants or undeclared names (`err = RD_KAFKA_RESP_ERR__WAIT_COORD;`), 154 string-literal actuals (`__qcore_literal__`, `action = "read PEM";`), 102 array objects and 14 records or other types. The lowering takes these as pointer copies or null decisions whose source no statement bound. 329 Unknown functions have such a leaf, 83 no other alias class; it is the largest alias-alone class: 4 functions (cio_chunk_is_file, LZ4F_optimalBSID, net_plain_close, rd_kafka_global_cnt_get) plus 2 with a second alias class (format_acl_error_message, LZ4F_getErrorName); system slice 30 leaves / 7 functions. DISCHARGE: the lowering reads the Clang type of a copy's source and a decision's operand from the typed AST it already matches (P2's node matching) and binds nothing for a non-pointer object, an enumeration constant or a literal, while an int-typed name at a descriptor-kinded contract position (C04.6, W43-DESCRIPTOR-RESOURCE-TRACKING) keeps its identity; audited Lean that a non-pointer copy preserves the frame, negative controls (descriptor ints, pointer-typed typedefs, casts), and a measured re-pin.

title: A copy of an unbound pointer formal outside the traversal exemption reports its source
why: Measured by W47-ALIAS-RESIDUALS-CENSUS (group formal-copied): 176 corpus unknown_alias leaves (175 first leaves) are `T *x = formal;` where the formal is never bound, typically a `void *` callback context (`rd_kafka_toppar_t *rktp = arg;`, `struct ctr_msgpack_decode_context *context = ctx;`). The W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL exemption leaves the copy unbound only when both names are declared single-level pointers to the lexical reader. 162 Unknown functions have such a leaf, 85 no other alias class, 56 are blocked by it plus exactly one other family (28 IND, 18 UNC, 7 RET); system 9 leaves / 6 functions, 2 of them alone. DISCHARGE: the exemption decided on the Clang types of both names (any object pointer type, `void *` included, typedefs resolved), with the formal's never-bound answer still required, audited Lean that the copy of an unbound pointer is unbound, negative controls (a bound formal, a pointer-to-pointer formal, a cast from an integer) and a measured re-pin.

title: Contracted allocator results dereferenced without a null test where the library's wrapper cannot return null
why: Measured by W47-ALIAS-RESIDUALS-CENSUS (group contracted-result-unguarded): 442 corpus unknown_alias leaves are pointers bound from a contracted allocator and dereferenced with no null test after the call: rd_calloc 222, rd_malloc 124, rd_strndup 34, calloc 30, mk_mem_alloc_z 20, rd_realloc 7, rd_strdup 6, mk_mem_alloc 6. qcore-provider-librdkafka's rd_malloc/rd_calloc/rd_strndup inherit libc::malloc/calloc/strndup, whose results are nullable, so the dereference obligation refuses. 178 Unknown functions have such a leaf, 123 no other alias class, 8 are blocked by it plus one other family. A plain libc calloc result dereferenced unguarded is a real obligation and stays refused. DISCHARGE: for each wrapper whose own body guarantees a non-null result (librdkafka's rd.h wrappers assert their allocation), a non-null result contract in its provider crate, checked against that body by W4 validation (never trusted), reviewed and pinned in revision mode at 046accf6 and the 66910c10 corpus source, with the provider gate and a measured re-pin; the abort-on-failure premise stated as an assumption of the contract.

title: Unknown-alias leaves that need a flow fact the projection does not have or the source does not state
why: Measured by W47-ALIAS-RESIDUALS-CENSUS on the integrated wave-47 baseline: the remaining corpus unknown_alias groups, each read lexically from the Clang AST of its own function (control flow is not followed): poisoned-by-refusal 900 leaves / 365 functions (a null-tested pointer with an unsupported statement of the same function between the test and the leaf; first refusal after the test, over all 950 poisoned leaves: IND 497, UNC 276, COND 98, other 79; they are discharged by the refusal families, W47-ACCESS-PATH-POSITION-RESIDUALS and P4), derived-local-unguarded 746 / 298 (copies, conditionals, arithmetic and address values with no null test), uncontracted-result-unguarded 705 / 360 (results of corpus or external callees with no contract or validated summary, P4), borrowed-path-unguarded 503 / 236 (a pointer read through an access path and dereferenced without a null test: the source's own obligation), guarded-other 262 / 167 (a null test with no refusal between: a release, an ambiguous join at a label, an unresolved callee effect), address-taken 202 / 85 (a pointer written through `&V` by an out-parameter call), statement-expression-unguarded 54 / 35, formal-handed-contracted 74 / 47, formal-not-handed 49 / 35, field-store-owner 40 / 25 (P5), global-pointer 6 / 5, peer-release 1 / 1. System slice: poisoned 340, address-taken 106, derived-local 96, statement-expression 68, borrowed-path 63, guarded-other 52 and smaller groups. Several are real obligations the C code does not discharge; none is a defect claim. DISCHARGE: each group either discharged by a named card with its own measured re-pin, or recorded as a decision that the obligation is the source's.
